method: public Result hardwoodColumnViews() throws IOException { long values = 0; long length = 0; long firstChars = 0; try (HardwoodContext context = BenchContext.create(); ParquetFileReader reader = ParquetFileReader.open(InputFile.of(FILE), context); ColumnReaders columns = reader.buildColumnReaders(ColumnProjection.columns(COLUMNS)).build()) { while (columns.nextBatch()) { for (String name : COLUMNS) { ColumnReader column = columns.getColumnReader(name); BinaryWindows binary = BinaryWindows.of(column); LeafValidity validity = LeafValidity.of(column); boolean nulls = validity.hasNulls(); for (int i = 0; i < column.getRecordCount(); i++) { if (nulls && validity.isNull(i)) { continue; } int start = binary.start(i); values++; length += binary.end(i) - start; firstChars += binary.buffer(i)[start]; } } } } return new Result(values, length, firstChars); }
